meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你给的文字(文章、笔记、主题等)变成一部不拍实景的讲解视频:所有画面(排版、图形、图表)由它按场景设计,并逐步产出故事板、脚本,最后渲染成 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当你把一篇文章、笔记或主题交给 Claude,要求做成讲解类视频(如概念拆解、教程、列表盘点),且没有具体网站或产品画面需要拍摄时触发。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成一个概念讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会先确认简报并规划故事板。

say.text: 把我的笔记变成不拍实景的教程视频,时长 2 分钟。
say.note: 脚本会按目标长度编写。

say.text: 用列表盘点形式讲解“复利”这个主题。
say.note: 会按列表结构设计教学顺序。

howto.what_en: Turns whatever text you give (article, notes, a topic) into a faceless explainer video — no real footage or site capture, visuals are invented per scene (typography, diagrams, data-viz), and Claude builds storyboard, script, and final render.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn an article, notes, or a topic into an explainer-style video (concept breakdown, how-to, listicle) with no website or product footage to capture.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a concept explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the brief and plans a storyboard first.

say_en.text: Make a 2-minute faceless tutorial from my notes.
say_en.note: The script is drafted to fit the requested length.

say_en.text: Do a listicle-style explainer on compound interest.
say_en.note: The lesson is structured as a listicle.
